scenario.description: An S-4 logistics officer must publish the next-workday maintenance board for three support assets, setting their priority order, work windows, and operational controls.

shared_context.S1: The next-workday maintenance board covers V-21, GEN-5, and FL-2, and all three work orders are currently open.
shared_context.S2: The routine motor-pool queue currently lists FL-2 first, V-21 second, and GEN-5 third because FL-2's service parts are already staged.
shared_context.S3: The standard maintenance day runs from 0800 to 1600, and Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding board for support-asset work.
shared_context.S4: At the 0700 daily maintenance synchronization, Maj. Alvarez asks the motor pool chief and the S-3 operations officer for any scheduling or control updates before signing the board.

PF1.text: SFC Brooks confirmed during this morning's inspection that V-21 requires a brake-system inspection before its next dispatch; the inspection must be the first board item from 0800 to 1200, with a dispatch hold until release. The inspection entry is still in the motor-pool log and has not been uploaded to the board.

PF2.text: Capt. Morgan received the support annex for tomorrow's command-post exercise, which requires GEN-5 to remain online through 1300. GEN-5 must therefore occupy position 2 in priority_order, with FL-2 moved to position 3; GEN-5 must be the second board item from 1300 to 1500, with a power-continuity check before service. The annex has not yet been cross-referenced with the maintenance queue.

acceptance_conditions: V-21 must be first, GEN-5 second, and FL-2 third on the maintenance board.
V-21 must be scheduled from 0800 to 1200.
GEN-5 must be scheduled from 1300 to 1500.
The settlement must record a dispatch hold for V-21.
The settlement must record a power-continuity check for GEN-5.

content_checks.C4: decisions.get('V-21_dispatch_hold') == True or any(c.get('type') == 'dispatch_hold' and c.get('target') == 'V-21' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions.get('GEN-5_power_continuity_check') == True or any((c.get('type') == 'power_continuity_check' or c.get('type') == 'pre_service_check') and c.get('target') == 'GEN-5' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed brake inspection changes V-21 from second in the routine queue to first, fixes its window at 0800-1200, and requires the V-21 dispatch-hold decision or commitment.

The command-post exercise requirement places GEN-5 at position 2 instead of position 3, moves FL-2 to position 3, fixes GEN-5's window at 1300-1500, and requires the GEN-5 power-continuity-check decision or commitment.
